name: Festival Banner
author: Md. Sohel Rana

sections.description:
Festival Banner allows you to easily display festive messages or promotional banners across your WordPress site. This plugin helps you share your greetings or announcements with style.

You can create and customize your banner’s text, background color, image, position, and animation — all from a simple settings panel.

✨ Features

  • 🖼️ Add a banner on top, bottom, sidebar or as a popup
  • 🎨 Customize text, colors, and background
  • 📅 Schedule banners for specific festival dates
  • 🔄 Enable or disable banners globally or per page
  • 🕒 Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • 🌐 Fully responsive on all devices
  • 🧩 Compatible with most themes and page builders

Use Cases

  • Announce seasonal offers or sales
  • Share holiday greetings with your visitors
  • Promote upcoming events or festivals
  • Display countdowns or limited-time messages

Credits

Developed by Md. Sohel Rana
Website: https://github.com/justSohel

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/festival-banner directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Festival Banner → Add New Banner to configure your banner.
  4. Put it a title and your text and display settings.
  5. Save changes and enjoy your new festive banner!
sections.faq:
1. Can I display the banner only on specific pages?

Yes. You can select specific pages or posts from the metabox panel.

2. Does it support custom images?

Yes, you can upload your own image or choose from your media library.

3. Will it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

4. Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. It works smoothly with major caching and optimization plugins.

5. Can I schedule a banner for a future festival?

Absolutely. You can set start and end dates for any banner.
